# Data Source: tfe_agent_pool

Gets information about an agent pool.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        tfe.data_tfe_agent_pool.DataTfeAgentPool(self, "test",
            name="my-agent-pool-name",
            organization="my-org-name"
        )
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the agent pool.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Name of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_project_ids` (Set of String) The set of project IDs that have permission to use the agent pool.
- `allowed_workspace_ids` (Set of String) The set of workspace IDs that have permission to use the agent pool.
- `excluded_workspace_ids` (Set of String) The set of workspace IDs that are excluded from the scope of the agent pool.
- `id` (String) The agent pool ID.
- `organization_scoped` (Boolean) Whether or not the agent pool can be used by all workspaces in the organization.
